tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. The colour logo sits here in light, the reverse logo in dark.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for callouts, quotes and section bands. Takes `ink` text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and the logo's letters, on `paper` and `blush`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and dates on `paper` and `blush`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and dividers on `paper`. Decorative only; not for control borders.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand purple. The bracketed [AI] in every colour logo (3.9:1 on white, 4.8:1 on black: logo and 24px+ lettering only), and one highlighted block per layout. Never a page ground behind long text, never small text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: The one-colour white logo and 24px+ lettering on `signal` (3.9:1). No small text on `signal`.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Links and the bracketed [AI] in running text on `paper`: a deeper purple in light and a paler one in dark so small text stays readable (5.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: hero lines and posters. Lowercase.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Building and Using Blockchain and AI Safely
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a title. Sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Join us for monthly sessions with founders, engineers and investors.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags, dates and captions. Lowercase, tracked out.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon or tag and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and tags; gap between a heading and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between paragraphs' blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The block unit: grid pitch for block patterns, gap between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: blocks, buttons, cards, images. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Only where a hard corner would pixelate: inputs and small tags.
